R1.title: robots.txt fetch status
R1.basis: 4xx means a crawler may access any resource; 5xx means it must assume complete disallow.

R2.title: Verdict per crawler and path, with the deciding line
R2.basis: The most specific match, by octets, wins; an equivalent allow should win.

R3.title: A crawler's own group drops the * rules
R3.basis: A crawler obeys the group matching its token and uses * only if none matches.

R4.title: Rules aimed at retired tokens
R4.basis: The page does not mention anthropic-ai or Claude-Web, so nothing documents them as retired. Carries no weight.

R5.title: Search and training siblings handled differently
R5.sourceName: OpenAI crawler documentation (and the other operators' pages in bots.json)
R5.basis: Operators document separate tokens for training, search and user fetches, each controlled on its own.

R6.title: CDN-managed blocks and Content-Signal lines
R6.basis: Cloudflare prepends managed directives and a Content-Signal policy to the site's robots.txt.

R7.title: Sitemap declared and reachable
R7.basis: Crawlers may interpret records outside the protocol, such as Sitemap.

P1.title: X-Robots-Tag header
P1.sourceName: Google Search Central: robots meta tag and X-Robots-Tag
P1.basis: Google honours X-Robots-Tag, including crawler-scoped values. Apple and Amazon document page controls too (see bots.json).

P2.title: Robots meta tags and snippet controls
P2.sourceName: Google Search Central: robots meta tag and X-Robots-Tag
P2.basis: Google honours noindex, nosnippet, max-snippet and data-nosnippet. In meta names it honours only googlebot and googlebot-news.

P3.title: Status, redirects and canonical
P3.basis: rel=canonical in HTML or the Link header is a strong signal of the preferred URL.

P4.title: Readable text without JavaScript
P4.sourceName: Vercel and MERJ, The rise of the AI crawler (2024-12-17)
P4.basis: Server-log study: none of the major AI crawlers measured, including GPTBot and ClaudeBot, rendered JavaScript. Data from 2024.

P5.title: JSON-LD parses and declares a type
P5.basis: Google recommends JSON-LD for structured data. No AI crawler operator documents using it.

E1.title: Response to each crawler's user agent against the baseline
E1.sourceName: PPC Land on the HasData study (2026-10-08)
E1.basis: 234 of 592 sites that disallow GPTBot still served it a page; 178 blocked it at the firewall while robots.txt said nothing. Secondary coverage of a vendor study using datacenter IPs.

I1.title: llms.txt present
I1.sourceName: Let's Data Science on an Ahrefs study (2026-06-16)
I1.basis: 97% of llms.txt files received no requests in May 2026. Reported for information; carries no weight.
